approved_game_role: Core survival fuel, campfire and heating resource.
geometry_contract: One or several split logs with fibrous cut ends, bark edges, irregular wedges and sane mass/volume; source model is an editable starting point, not approved dimensions. Distinguish a single fuel item from bundled stack arrangement through assembly templates.
materials_uv_textures: Original bark albedo, end-grain rings, split fibers, splinter roughness, seasonal species color range, damp/soot/fire damage overlays; UV seams along the bark and cut faces; condition levels 0–3.
rig_animation_state_contract: dry / damp / soaked / smoldering / charred; loose, small pile and stacked storage placements use arrangements of the same base logs; do not commission each photo or bundle as a unique Blender master.
render_directions_pivots: 2:1 isometric 80x40px/m; upper-left light; consistent world/ground/held/inventory pivots
collision_and_interactions: Campfire, stove and furnace fuel, foraging/chopping loot, storage, ignition and fuel value. W01 specifies burn energy, moisture, weight, stack limits, scent/noise/heat and world collision; F04 handles wood harvest systems.
dependencies: W09 QA and founder visual review

geometry_contract: Primitive hand-held bone bludgeon with readable tapered shaft, grip zone and heavier striking end; distinguish base bone-club geometry from large, spiked or jawbone alternatives, which require separate identity review.
materials_uv_textures: Original ivory/bone material with pore/edge shading, subtle anatomy-inspired irregularity, dirty cracks, grip binding where appropriate and condition 0–3 wear; use entirely original textures and geometry.
rig_animation_state_contract: idle, gripped, block, swing, impact, dropped and broken; animation frames reuse F05 body and a stable weapon pivot; no independent mesh per swing direction.
render_directions_pivots: 2:1 isometric 80x40px/m; upper-left light; consistent world/ground/held/inventory pivots
collision_and_interactions: Improvised close-range melee weapon with blunt impact, weapon reach, durability, repair/crafting and sound; W01 owns combat stats and break logic, F05 attachment poses, F12 directional export and W09 combat-art QA.
dependencies: W09 QA and founder visual review
